description: This file contains TypeScript code for managing model discovery and authentication storage in an OpenClaw agent, including functions for creating and normalizing model registries, handling credentials, and interfacing with external modules.

classes.name: InMemoryAuthStorageBackendLike
classes.description: Interface for in-memory auth storage backend with lock mechanism.

classes.name: PiModelRegistryClassLike
classes.description: Type describing a class or constructor for PiModelRegistry with optional create method.

methods.name: createInMemoryAuthStorageBackend
methods.description: Creates an in-memory auth storage backend with initial data.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: normalizeRegistryModel
methods.description: Normalizes a model object, applying plugin and compatibility transformations.

methods.name: instantiatePiModelRegistry
methods.description: Instantiates a PiModelRegistry, using create method if available.

methods.name: createOpenClawModelRegistry
methods.description: Creates a model registry with normalized models for OpenClaw.

methods.name: scrubLegacyStaticAuthJsonEntries
methods.description: Removes legacy static API key entries from auth JSON files.

methods.name: createAuthStorage
methods.description: Creates an auth storage instance, supporting various storage backends.

methods.name: resolvePiCredentials
methods.description: Resolves credentials from environment and profile store.

methods.name: discoverAuthStorage
methods.description: Discovers and creates auth storage for a given agent directory.

methods.name: discoverModels
methods.description: Discovers and creates a model registry for a given agent directory.
